verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a public RESTful API for processing applicant data and documents, and says it gives full control over the verification flow. It also offers a sandbox for testing integrations with app tokens, webhooks for event notifications, and an LLM-friendly docs index (llms.txt with markdown versions of every page). missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and detailed evidence on endpoint coverage and authentication.
